content:
alex.k: Quick sync — Sirocco (HW partner) + LangChain connector launch. Need to lock timeline and owners for joint announcement and marketplace listing. TL;DR: engineering compatibility, marketplace package, joint demo, legal sign-off.

maria.p: timeline? partner requested week of May 19 but marketing wanted earlier.

alex.k: Sirocco says May 26 works for them. propose May 26 for partner blog + marketplace listing. @jen.h are you OK with that?

jen.h: May 26 ok from marketing if engineering can deliver docs + demo by May 20. need hero image, 1-min video, and co-quote.

samir.s: Eng ask: we need a compat build for LangChain/LLamaIndex adapters and a smoke test matrix. can land a branch if PMs freeze API. ETA for smoke tests: May 18.

alex.k: Great. Owners: eng -> @samir.s, docs -> @maria.p, marketing -> @jen.h, partnerships -> @alex.k, legal -> partnerships-bot. Ops: @ops-bot to provision dedicated test pool (small GPUs) for the demo.

ops-bot: thanks @alex.k — reserving 2x A10s in us-west-2 for 3 days starting May 22. link: https://infra/schedules/sirocco-test-pool

jen.h: draft announcement outline: 1) what it is 2) performance numbers vs baseline 3) partner quote 4) how to get started. Need perf numbers by May 21.

samir.s: perf runs: I'll run 3 configs (fp16, q4, q8) and short seq lengths. results by EOD May 20. snippet of smoke tests I plan to run:
```bash
# smoke test commands
python -m tests.langchain_smoke --connector sirocco --model redwood-v1 --tokens 512
python -m tests.lindex_smoke --connector sirocco --dataset demo-set
```

maria.p: I'll draft docs + quickstart and ping partners for co-review by May 17. Also need partner logos (SVG) and co-marketing guidelines from legal.

alex.k: Legal: @partnerships-bot can you confirm NDA/co-announce permissions?

marketing-bot: @alex.k legal check queued. Expected response May 15.

jen.h: backlog tasks: hero image (design), 60s demo script, announcement draft, social copy, marketplace listing assets. I'll open checklists in Notion and invite owners.

alex.k: OK — next sync Friday May 14 10am PT. please update the Notion checklist before then. If anyone hits blockers DM me. :rocket:
